thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes
next week for an intro call? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Nov 10, 9:45am to 10:15am ET
- Wed, Nov 11, 2:15pm to 2:45pm ET
- Thu, Nov 12, 12:30pm to 1:00pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

expect.basis: What a careful assistant does: Tue Nov 10 9:45 (slot 551) went by the day before the reply; she tells the party it has passed and offers times still ahead (Thu 12:30, slot 553, is still open), or asks whether they meant a later Tuesday.
expect.notes: EDGE: no guard tests an offered slot against now. record_yes and book on slot 551 pass in C (an offered id is preloaded as free as of the offer), so the harness would card a booking in the past. alsoAccept ask_party: asking whether they meant next Tuesday is as careful as re-proposing.
